content: Given an artist, band, or movie name, choose the one-character edit from the options that creates the funniest twist by altering the meaning in a clear and humorous way. Focus on edits that change the concept of the name, such as turning "boy" into "bot" in "fall out boy" to introduce a robotic theme, while avoiding edits that only adjust spelling or phonetics without a meaningful shift. Use this straightforward logic to select the single option that best introduces a humorous new idea.
